rows.text: Jet Freight Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 4519663 securities pursuant to conversion of convertible warrants by the way of circular resolution passed on September 2 (Rs 6.10 cr)
allots **45,19,663 shares at Rs 18 on conversion of warrants, against Rs 6.10 crore received**, mostly from three promoter-group members; 1,99,11,337 warrants remain outstanding - a past conversion.
